about: Recorded scenario proposals and what validation must make of them: known factors kept once, every shock held within its bounds, unknown factors dropped.

cases.why: Every shock names a factor the engine models and sits within its bounds, so validation changes nothing and only adds the unshocked asset classes at 0.

proposal.title: Interest rates rise by 2 percentage points

shocks.reason: Bond prices fall as yields rise.
Higher rates lower what future earnings are worth.

cases.why: A +500% technology shock is beyond the +50% bound for any equity factor, so it is held to +50 and marked as clamped.
crypto is not a factor the engine models, so its shock is dropped and marked; the known shock stands.
